“Both of my parents each got diagnosed with cancer within a week of each other.”

 Ashley is the VP of Product at OpenAI for Health and this is a very special episode for me. We talked about how we both use AI to help our parents fight cancer — including preparing for doctor visits, researching treatments, and coping with our emotions as caregivers. Topics include:

→ Do doctors mind when patients bring AI research?
→ How ChatGPT caught a risky treatment before it was given
→ How to make time for your parents with a demanding job

Some quotes from Ashley:

“I always felt like there was no more time in the day. Then someone gets sick and you realize what you can make time for and what can drop.”

“You also have to care for yourself as a caregiver. You have to make sure you’re budgeting time for your own mental health.”

“The treatment she was about to be given would have had a really bad contraindication. She narrowly avoided it because she ran it through Chat.”
